Frontend: readiness badges render with correct '0/2 participants'/'1/2 participants' text + amber styling on 4 draft rows; autosend checkbox defaults to checked; send button flips between 'Email invites now' and 'Create invite links'; submitting 2 emails hits POST /api/v1/reverse-auctions/{aid}/invite 200 and shows toast '2 invites prepared · share the links below.' with the two emails appearing in the Pending-invite-links list. design_issues.screen: Reverse auctions · Pending invite links rows
issues: Pending-invite-link list rows do not expose a data-testid (e.g. auction-invite-pending-{token}). Visually populated and Copy-link works, but adding testids would make tests more deterministic. Minor.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend fallback template logic is clean: tpl is resolved from Mongo default (is_default:true) first, then baked-in constants — admins never have to pre-seed. Explicit bogus template_id still 404s. Correct.

participant_count added via a per-row count_documents(reverse_auction_participants). Fine for current volume (6 auctions) but if list grows large consider a single $group aggregation to avoid N round-trips.
NoticesPanel URL sync uses history.replaceState (confirmed via history.length delta=0) — no polluting back-button. Good UX.
AdminAuctionsE readiness badge amber/emerald styling driven by participant_count vs needed=2 — matches spec.
Pending-invite-link row rendering lacks data-testid attributes; recommend adding `data-testid="auction-invite-pending-{token}"` for stability of future regression tests.
